title: Validation-order documentation in deliver_handler is a strong pattern
description: kith-peer DeliverHandler documents its validation order explicitly (e.g., 'Step 1: validate senderUserId before any DB access'). This makes the security model auditable and prevents future contributors from reordering steps in ways that would allow TOCTOU issues. A future contributor might suggest 'simplifying' by inlining or reordering — defend it: the explicit order is a security property, not verbosity.
